machine_minds.title: AI read words inside a scroll no one could open
machine_minds.summary: CT scans of scrolls carbonized by Vesuvius in 79 AD, paired with machine learning trained to spot faint ink, are recovering text letter by letter without unrolling them.
machine_minds.thought: These scrolls could never be read without destroying them.
machine_minds.finding: Hidden text can be read while the scroll stays rolled shut.
machine_minds.why: It opens a whole library of ancient writing that was thought to be lost.

cosmos.title: The early universe grew galaxies faster than expected
cosmos.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope keeps finding large, bright galaxies just a few hundred million years after the Big Bang.
cosmos.thought: Big galaxies needed billions of years to form.
cosmos.finding: They appear far earlier than models allowed.
cosmos.why: Our timeline of how the universe built its structure may need revising.

deep_past.title: Neanderthals never fully disappeared
deep_past.summary: Genome studies show that most people alive today carry a small share of Neanderthal DNA, inherited from interbreeding tens of thousands of years ago.
deep_past.thought: Neanderthals were a dead-end branch, replaced by our ancestors.
deep_past.finding: They live on in the DNA of billions of people.
deep_past.why: The line between us and them is blurrier than textbooks once taught.

reality.title: An octopus thinks partly with its arms
reality.summary: Most of an octopus's neurons sit in its arms rather than its central brain, and the arms can sense and react with surprising independence.
reality.thought: A mind lives in one central brain.
reality.finding: Thinking can be spread through a body.
reality.why: It changes what we mean by a mind, with lessons for designing AI.

beyond.title: Bigfoot hunter's DNA claim runs into Cornell's denial
beyond.summary: A man known as Snake the Bigfoot Hunter says remains he found in the Adirondacks in 2024 were DNA-tested at Cornell and shown to be part Neanderthal. Cornell says it never tested any such remains.
beyond.thought: Remains found in the Adirondacks are a Bigfoot, confirmed by Cornell DNA testing.
beyond.finding: Cornell says it has never tested any supposed Sasquatch corpse, and no independent analysis has been published.
beyond.why: The exhibit drew large crowds at the New York State Fair.
